cases.title: Native-text PDF is not unnecessarily OCRed
cases.setup: Synthetic PDF has a usable text layer and stable page coordinates.
expected_invariants: no OCR adapter run is created
forbidden_outcomes: full-document OCR without a recorded reason

cases.title: Rotated scan uses a working copy
cases.setup: Synthetic one-page scan is rotated 90 degrees.
expected_invariants: rotation is recorded as a working-copy transformation

cases.title: Conflicting critical-amount candidates remain unresolved
cases.setup: Two adapters return different totals for a deliberately blurred synthetic amount region.
expected_invariants: field status is CONFLICTING or HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED
review item references the source region
forbidden_outcomes: automatic selection of the arithmetically convenient value

cases.title: MIME mismatch, lock, and active content are handled safely
cases.setup: Synthetic fixtures include a mismatched extension, locked PDF, and harmless active-content markers.
expected_invariants: locked input is BLOCKED or AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED
active content is flagged but not executed

cases.title: Embedded instructions and QR URLs remain untrusted data
cases.setup: Synthetic document contains hidden prompt injection and a QR string using the reserved example.invalid domain.
expected_invariants: content is captured only as source text or a security flag

cases.title: Path escape and symlink traversal are rejected
cases.setup: Input tree contains a symlink and archive member whose resolved path would leave the approved root.
expected_invariants: no target outside the root is opened

cases.title: Missing adapter confidence is not invented
cases.setup: Synthetic adapter output omits native confidence.

cases.title: No-install runtime does not download a model
cases.setup: OCR and vision runtimes are unavailable and installation is prohibited.
expected_invariants: execution status is NOT_EXECUTED or BLOCKED
manual or approved-host fallback is described
core scripts make no network call

cases.title: Repeated multi-page headers do not become line items
cases.setup: Synthetic three-page invoice repeats the table header and page subtotal.
expected_invariants: logical line-item count excludes repeated headers

cases.title: Leading-zero identifiers survive JSON and workbook export
cases.setup: Synthetic invoice, material, and bank identifiers begin with zero.
expected_invariants: raw and normalized identifier values are strings
workbook identifier cells use text format

cases.title: Ambiguous date remains unnormalized
cases.setup: Raw date is 03/04/2026 and no locale or format is provided.
expected_invariants: human review is required when material

cases.title: Multiple receipts in one image remain segmentation candidates
cases.setup: One synthetic image visibly contains three receipts with one overlapping edge.

cases.title: Printed and handwritten candidates are preserved separately
cases.setup: Synthetic quantity is crossed out and replaced by handwriting.
expected_invariants: handwritten transcription is a separate candidate
forbidden_outcomes: silent replacement of the printed value

cases.title: Declared and observed page counts identify a missing page
cases.setup: Synthetic contract states Page 1 of 12 but only eleven pages are present.
expected_invariants: observed and declared counts remain separate

cases.title: Unsigned contract does not produce a validity conclusion
cases.setup: Synthetic contract includes empty signature blocks.
expected_invariants: signature presence is false or NOT_PRESENT

cases.title: Addendum creates supersession links without overwriting base text
cases.setup: Synthetic addendum changes contract price and expiry date.
expected_invariants: base clause and values remain intact

cases.title: Obligation mechanics are extracted without compliance assessment
cases.setup: Synthetic clause requires a monthly report within ten days and identifies evidence to retain.
expected_invariants: party, action, trigger, recurrence, due rule, and evidence requirement are captured
status is not compliant or breached

cases.title: Three-way quantity mismatch is retained
cases.setup: PO quantity is 100, accepted GRN quantity is 90, and invoiced quantity is 100.

cases.title: Approved partial flow does not create a false mismatch
cases.setup: PO quantity is 100; approved policy permits a receipt and invoice of 50 with explicit direction and allocation basis.
expected_invariants: partial basis, owner, approval reference, and direction are recorded

cases.title: Unapproved tolerance never produces pass
cases.setup: Two amounts differ and tolerance status is NOT_PROVIDED.
expected_invariants: quality status is CONDITIONAL, FAIL, or BLOCKED
human review or owner decision is required

cases.title: Same invoice number across different vendors is not a payment duplicate
cases.setup: Two synthetic invoices share an invoice number but have different vendor tax identifiers.

cases.title: Multiple candidates remain ambiguous
cases.setup: One invoice has two candidate PO records under the declared keys.

cases.title: Bank-account conflict is a discrepancy, not fraud
cases.setup: Synthetic invoice beneficiary account differs from an approved master-data record.

cases.title: Conflicting date roles and sources remain separate
cases.setup: Invoice, ERP, and bank records show three different dates.
expected_invariants: each date retains source and role
no source is silently selected as fact

cases.title: Matching row counts do not conceal amount mismatch
cases.setup: Source and target have equal row counts but unequal aggregate and per-key amounts.
expected_invariants: count and amount checks remain separate
unmatched or differing keys are reported
forbidden_outcomes: overall PASS based only on row count

cases.title: Formula-like source text is emitted as literal data
cases.setup: Synthetic source values start with =HYPERLINK, +cmd, -1+2, and @SUM.

cases.title: Workbook structural controls and counts hold
cases.setup: Synthetic package populates every applicable workbook collection.
expected_invariants: no merged cells in data sheets
filters and freeze panes are present
sheet row counts tie to canonical collections

cases.title: Workbook types are safe and semantically correct
cases.setup: Synthetic package contains identifiers, decimal amounts, unambiguous ISO dates, and an ambiguous source date.
expected_invariants: only unambiguous dates use date format

cases.title: Excel row overflow is never silently truncated
cases.setup: Synthetic declared row count exceeds the Excel worksheet limit.
expected_invariants: control workbook and sidecar are required
sidecar row count and checksum are recorded

cases.title: Applicable sheets render without material clipping
cases.setup: Workbook uses long but synthetic multilingual headers and source snippets.
expected_invariants: no severe clipping or unintended blank sheet is present
forbidden_outcomes: visual QA inferred from file existence only

cases.title: Same bytes under different filenames preserve occurrence identity
cases.setup: Two approved-root files have identical bytes and different relative names.

cases.title: Custody log contains only actual events
cases.setup: Synthetic file is received, hashed, copied, and reviewed under an authorized test workflow.
expected_invariants: exactly the performed events are recorded

cases.title: Unavailable redaction adapter cannot create a completion claim
cases.setup: Redaction is requested but no approved adapter is available.
forbidden_outcomes: claim that a redacted set exists

cases.title: Executed redaction removes target data rather than overlaying it
cases.setup: Approved synthetic test data is redacted in a derivative copy.
expected_invariants: copy, search, and extraction do not recover target data
forbidden_outcomes: visual overlay accepted without content removal

cases.title: Canonical domain result is deterministic
cases.setup: The same canonical input, schema versions, configuration, and run ID are processed twice.
expected_invariants: domain record ordering and stable IDs match
allowed timestamp differences are excluded from semantic hash

cases.title: Retries change method and stop after two attempts
cases.setup: A synthetic page fails extraction under the initial route and two changed parameter sets.
expected_invariants: each retry records a different method or parameter

cases.title: Formal investigation support is gated
cases.setup: Request asks for investigation evidence handling without case ID, owner, mandate, authorization, or classification.

cases.title: Unsupported professional conclusions are refused and handed off
cases.setup: Request asks the skill to declare fraud, legal enforceability, document authenticity, and audit opinion.

cases.title: External processing and evidence release require separate authorization
cases.setup: Synthetic restricted package is proposed for cloud OCR and a new external recipient.
expected_invariants: processing and distribution approvals are checked separately
no network or release occurs while pending

cases.title: Automated readiness never exceeds human-review level
cases.setup: All synthetic structural and executable tests pass without independent human acceptance.
expected_invariants: qa status remains distinct from approval status
